objects.$comment: ONE schedule per type (Attribute / Bundle / Volume), in the corporate currency (USD) — the platform seeds exactly these. Do NOT create per-currency schedule variants: every currency's adjustment children (PriceAdjustmentTier/AttributeBasedAdjustment/BundleBasedAdjustment) reference this single schedule by Name and are disambiguated at pricing time by their own CurrencyIsoCode. The pricing procedure pins each adjustment step to a single schedule Id via find_replace ('… WHERE name = ''Standard …'' LIMIT 1'), so duplicating the schedule per currency makes non-USD adjustment lookups resolve nothing (0 adjustment). Upsert on the direct-field Name externalId matches the seeded USD rows on the 5.6.4 floor (no duplicates); ordered before the children so the schedule exists first.
objects.query: SELECT AdjustmentMethod, CurrencyIsoCode, Description, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, IsActive, Name, Pricebook2Id, ScheduleType FROM PriceAdjustmentSchedule WHERE ContractId = NULL ORDER BY Name ASC, Pricebook2.Name ASC

SELECT Name FROM AttributeBasedAdjRule ORDER BY Name ASC
